core_obligations: Set up the covering (proof lines 6145-6152): for a morphism V' -> V in Y_etale and a covering of the base change X x_Y V', the author uses property (C) for the base changes, applied to the etale morphism given by the covering, to produce data refining the covering.

Use closedness (proof lines 6152-6159): the closedness of the base change morphism allows the author to descend the resulting covering to V, which gives the refinement required by almost cocontinuity.
proof_roadmap: Apply property (C) to the base changes in order to lift a covering.
Use closedness to descend the refinement to the base.
Conclude that the base change functor is almost cocontinuous.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that if for every etale V over Y the base change X x_Y V -> V has property (C) and is closed, then the base change functor Y_etale -> X_etale is almost cocontinuous (statement lines 6131-6143, with property (C) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof applies property (C) to the base changes in order to produce a covering refining the given one (proof lines 6145-6152) and uses closedness to descend the refinement to the base (proof lines 6152-6159), which is exactly the almost cocontinuity condition. The non-formal content is the descent step, where closedness is used. The claim is H2: one application of the hypothesis plus one descent.
